subject: skill/stack/celery-redis
claim: For an application that implements Celery with Redis, make task side effects idempotent, choose acknowledgement behavior deliberately, bound retries with backoff, and route long-running tasks explicitly. Agentic Dynamics does not operate a maintained Celery task system; Celery appears only as a requirement in a built-in story prompt.
